spans.s:
m. (-हः)
1 A paternal grandfather.
2 A name of BRAHMĀ, the great father of all.
f. (-ही)
A paternal grandmother.
E.
पितृ a father, and मह aff.

m. (-ता)
A father.
dual (-रौ)
Mother and father, parents.
plu. always. (-रः)
1 Paternal ancestors.
2 The manes, or the deceased and deified progenitors of mankind, inhabiting a peculiar region or heaven, or according to some, the orbit of the moon.
E.
पा to nourish, Uṇādi aff. तृच्.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Paternal, ancestral, parental, obsequial, relating or belonging to parents or progenitors.
E.
पितृ a sire, and कन् aff.

n. (-क्थं)
Paternal property.
E.
पितृ, and ऋक्थ wealth.

n. (-र्म्म)
Obsequial rites.
E.
पितृ, and कर्म्मन् act.

n. (-र्य्यं)
Obsequial rites.
E.
पितृ, and कार्य्य to be done.

n. (-नं)
A cemetery.
E.
पितृ an ancestor, and कानन a wood.

f. (-या)
Obsequial rites.
E.
पितृ, and क्रिया ceremony.

m. (-णः)
A class of progenitors, the sons of the Ṛṣis or Prajāpatis: the principal classes are the Sonasads descended from VIRĀṬA, the Agniṣvāttas from MARĪCI, Barhiṣads from ATRI, Somapās from BHṚGU, Haviṣmats from AṄGIRAS, Ājyapas from PULASTYA, Sukālins from VASIṢṬHA; there are also the Agnidagdhas and Anagnidagdhas, Kāvyas and Saumyas.
E.
पितृ father (of mankind), गण a troop.

mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि)
Belonging to, or pertaining to a father.
E.
पितृ, and गामिन् what goes.

n. (-हं)
A burying ground, a cemetery.
E.
पितृ a deceased ancestor, and गृह a house.

m. (-कः)
A parricide.
E.
पितृ, and घातक slayer.

n. (-णं)
1 The part of the hand between the middle finger and thumb, sacred to the manes.
2 Gifts in honour of deceased relations, distributed at the Śrāddhas or funeral ceremonies.
3 The act of throwing water out of the right hand at seasons of ablution, by way of offering to the manes, or deceased ancestors in general.
E.
पितृ a father, a progenitor, and तर्पण satisfying.

ind.
From or by the father.
E.
पितृ, and तसि aff.

m. (-थिः)
Day of new moon, on which she rises invisible.
E.
पितृ a progenitor, and तिथि a lunar day, sacred to the manes.

n. (-र्थं)
1 Gaya, the city so called, where the performance of funeral sacrifices is peculiarly efficacious and meritorious.
2 The part between the forefinger and thumb, sacred to the manes.
E.
पितृ a progenitor, and तीर्थ a place of pilgrimage.

Paternity.
2

The state or condition of a Pitṛ, or deified progenitor.
E.
त्व added to पितृ.

n. (-नं)
Gift in honour of deceased ancestors.
E.
पितृ a progenitor, and दान giving or gift; also with कन् added, पितृदानक n. (-कं)

n. (-तं)
The tenth lunar asterism or Magha.
E.
पितृ, and दैवत divinity, presiding over the asterism.

m. (-तिः)
YAMA, regent of the dead.
E.
पितृ a deceased progenitor, and पति lord.

n. (-दं)
The world or state of the manes.
E.
पितृ, and पद degree.

n. (-त्रं)
A cup or vessel used at obsequial rites.
E.
पितृ, and पात्र a cup.

m. (-ता)
A paternal grandfather.
E.
पितृ a father, and पितृ the same, a father's father.

Twilight.
2

A father's mother.
E.
पितृ a deceased progenitor, and प्रसू the parent; the first is the time when the manes are abroad.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
1 Received from a father.
2 Inherited patrimonially.
E.
पितृ, and प्राप्त obtained.

m. (-न्धुः)
A remote or cognate kinsman by the father's side, as the son of the paternal grandfather's sister, of the paternal grandmother's sister, and of the father's maternal uncle.
E.
पितृ, and बन्धु a kinsman.

m. (-वः)
A remote kinsman of the paternal line: see the last.
E.
पितृ, and बान्धव a kinsman.

f. (-क्तिः)
Filial duty to a father.
E.
पितृ, and भक्ति devotion.

n. (-नं)
1 Food offered to the manes.
2 A father's food.
3 A kind of pulse: see Māṣa.
E.
पितृ, and भोजन food.

m. (-ता)
A father's brother.
E.
पितृ, and भ्रातृ a brother.

n. (-रं)
1 The paternal mansion.
2 A cemetery.
E.
पितृ, and मन्दिर a dwelling.

n. (-धं)
Obsequial rites.
E.
पितृ, and मेध sacrifice.

m. (-ज्ञः)
Obsequial rites.
E.
पितृ a progenitor, and यज्ञ sacrifice.

n. (-नं)
The carriage of the manes, a car to convey holy persons after their decease to heaven.
E.
पितृ a progenitor, and यान a vehicle.

m. (-कः)
The world or sphere of the manes: it is variously situated, but principally in the Bhuvas region or midheaven.
E.
पितृ, and लोक world.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Having a father living, &c.
E.
पितृ, and मतुप् poss. aff.

n. (-नं)
A cemetery, a place where dead bodies are burnt or buried.
E.
पितृ a deceased progenitor, वन a wood.

IVA.
2

A goblin.
E.
पितृवन a cemetery, in the seventh case, and चर who goes.

f. (-तिः)
A cemetery.
E.
पितृ a deceased progenitor, and वसति an abode.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Obedient to parents.
E.
पितृ, वाच् speech, पर attentive to.

m. (-व्यः)
A paternal uncle.
E.
पितृ a father, and व्यत् aff.

m. (-तः)
Who worships the manes.
n. (-तं)
Worship of ancestors, obsequial rites.
E.
पितृ, and व्रत obligation.

n. (-द्धं)
The obsequial ceremony of a father.
E.
पितृ, and श्राद्ध the rite.

f. (-सा)
A father's sister.
E.
पितृ a father, and खसृ a sister, स changed to ष; the compound may also be पितुःष्वसृ, पितुःखसृ, पितुस्खसृ.

mfn. (-भः-भा-भं)
Fatherly.
E.
पितृ, and सन्निभ like.

n. (-न्यं)
Ancestors collectively.
E.
पितृ, and सामान्य universality.

Twilight.
2

A father's mother.
E.
पितृ a ghost, and सू producing: see पितृप्रसू.

m. (-नः)
A guardian, a protector.
n. (-नं)
The abode of the manes.
E.
पितृ, and स्थान like, or in place of; a place, abode.

m. (-यः)
A guardian.
E.
पितृस्थान, and छ aff.

mf. (-यः-या)
A maternal aunt's son or daughter.
E.
पितृ, and स्वस्रीय sister's son, &c.

m. (-हा)
A parricide.
E.
पितृ, and हन् who kills.

n. (-त्तं)
Bile, the bilious humour.
E.
अपि certainly, दी to destroy, or देङ् to nourish, aff. क्त, deriv. irr., or तप to inflame, aff. क्त, and the radical letters transposed.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Of a yellow colour.
2 Drank, quaffed.
m. (-तः)
1 Yellow, the colour.
2

Safflower.
3

A topaz, a yellow gem.
4 A yellow pigment, prepared from the urine of kine.
n. (-तं)
1

Drinking.
2

Yellow orpiment.
f. (-ता)
1

Turmerick.
2

A medical plant, commonly Atais, (Betula.)
E.
पा to drink, aff. क्त; imbibed, literally, or figuratively, by the eye sight, &c.

mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं)
Antibilious.
f. (-घ्नी)
A plant, (Menispermum glabrum.)
n. (-घ्नं)
Ghee.
E.
पित्त bile, and घ्न what destroys.

m. (-रः)
Bilious fever.
E.
पित्त bile, and ज्वर fever.

mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि)
Removing bile, causing it to flow.
E.
पित्त, and द्राविन् what disperses.

n. (-क्तं)
Plethora: see रक्तपित्त.
E.
पित्त, and रक्त blood.

n. (-क्तं)
A yellow coloured gem, perhaps the topaz.
E.
पीत yellow, and रक्त coloured.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Bilious, relating to the bilious humour.
n. (-लं)
1

Brass.
2

The Bhojpatra or Birch tree, of which the bark is used for writing upon, &c.
f. (-ला)
A plant, (Jussieua repens.)
E.
पित्त bile, ला to get, to resemble, (in colour,) aff. ड.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Of a yellow colour.
m. (-लः)
Yellow, the colour.
n. (-लं)
Brass.
E.
पीत, and लच् aff.

mfn. (-त्र्याः-त्र्या-त्र्यं)
1 Paternal, ancestral.
2 Obsequial, relating to deceased progenitors.
m. (-त्र्यः)
A father's elder brother.
n. (-त्र्यं)
The part of the hand between the forefinger and thumb, sacred to the manes.
f. (-त्र्या)
1 One of the lunar asterisms, also

Magha.
2

Day of full moon.
3 Ceremonies performed in honour of the deceased on the day of full moon.
E.
पितृ a father, and यत् aff., रीङ् substituted for ऋ.

mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सत्)
1 Habitually falling or coming down.
2 Obtained, gained.
m. (-सन्)
A bird.
E.
पत to fall or alight, शतृ aff., and desiderative form; the reduplicate syllable omitted.

n. (-लं)
A road, a path, &c.
E.
पत to go, Uṇādi aff. सल, form irr.

n. (-कं)
1 Yellow orpiment.
2

Saffron.
3

Aloe-wood.
4

Brass.
5

Honey.
m. (-कः)
1 A sort of gentian, (G. Cherayta.)
2 The Tūn tree.
E.
पीत yellow, aff. कन्.

f. (-ली)
A sort of plantain.
E.
पीत yellow, कदली plantain.

n. (-न्दं)
The carrot.
E.
पीत yellow, and कन्द root.

Saffron.
2

Brass.
E.
पीत yellow, कावेर vile shape or substance.

n. (-ष्ठं)
Yellow sanders.
E.
पीत yellow, काष्ठ wood.

f. (-षा)
A sort of creeper with yellow flowers.
E.
पीत, and घोषा the plant; yellow Ghoṣā.

n. (-नं)
1 A yellow fragrant wood, considered as a yellow species of Sandal wood.
2

Turmerick.
3

Saffron.
E.
पीत yellow, and चन्दन Sandal.

m. (-कः)
A lamp.
E.
पीत yellow, चम्पक a flower, and कन् aff. of comparison; like the Campa in colour.

f. (-ता)
Yellowness.
E.
पीत्, and तल् aff.; also with त्व पीतत्वं.

m. (-ण्डः)
The tailor bird, (Sylvia sutoria.)
E.
पीत yellow, and तुण्ड a beak; the whole bird is of a light yellow colour.

f. (-ला)
A sort of creeper, a species of the heart-pea.
E.
पीत yellow, तैल oil.

n. (-रुः)
1 A sort of pine, (P. Devadāru.)
2 Another kind of pine, (Pinus longifolia.)
E.
पीत yellow, and दारु wood.

f. (-ग्धा)
1 A cow tied up to be milked.
2 Any milch cow.
E.
पीत drank, दुग्ध milk.

m. (-द्रुः)
1 A sort of Curcuma, (C. zanthorrhizon.)
2 A species of pine, (P. longifolia.)
E.
पीत yellow, and द्रु a tree.

m. (-नः)
1 The hog plum, (Spondias mangifera.)
2 A tree, (Pentaptera tomentosa.)
3 The waved leaf fig tree.
n. (-नं)
1

Saffron.
2

A sort of pine: see पीतदारु.
3 Yellow orpiment.
E.
पीत yellow, णी to go, or be, aff. ड.

f. (-र्णी)
A plant, commonly Bichati; a name applied to the nettle, or a plant of the same class, (Tragia involucrata.)
E.
पीत yellow, and पर्ण leaf.

f. (-दा)
A small bird, the Maina, (Turdus salica.)
E.
पीत yellow, पाद a foot.

m. (-ष्पः)
1 A species of

Karṇikāra.
2

A sort of Tabernæmontana.
f. (-ष्पा-ष्पी)
Yellow barleria.
E.
पीत yellow, and पुष्प a flower; it may be applied to any plant with yellow flowers.

m. (-लः)
A tree, (Trophis aspera.)
E.
पीत yellow, and फल fruit.

Turmerick.
2

Yellow sand.
E.
पीत yellow, and बालुका sand or dust.

m. (-णिः)
A yellow gem, a topaz.
E.
पीत yellow, and मणि a gem.

m. (-कः)
A small bird, (Loxia philippensis.)
E.
पीत yellow, and मस्तक the head.

m. (-ण्डः)
A gallinule.
E.
पीत yellow, मुण्ड the head.

m. (-द्गः)
A sort of bean, a yellow variety of the Phaseo lus Mūṅg.
E.
पीत yellow, and मुद्ग Mūṅg.

f. (-थी)
Yellow jasmine.
E.
पीत, and यूथी jasmine.

m. (-गः)
1 The fibres of the lotus.
2 A yellow colour.
E.
पीत, and राग colour.

n. (-कं)
Brass.
E.
पीतल yellow, कन् added.

n. (-हं)
Yellow brass, queen's metal, or a mixed metal, resembling gold.
E.
पीत yellow, and लोह iron.

mfn. (-साः-साः-सः)
Dressed in yellow.
m. (-साः)
A name of KṚṢṆA.
E.
पीत yellow, वासस् vesture.

m. (-लः)
A tree, (Pentaptera.)
E.
पीत yellow, and शास्त the Śāl tree.

Sandal.
2

A yellow gem, a topaz.
3 A tree, (Alangium hexapetalum.)
n. (-रं)
A yellow sort of Sandal wood.
E.
पीत yellow, and सार essence.

n. (-रि)
Antimony.
E.
पीत yellow, सार essence, aff. इन्.

m. (-कः)
A tree, (Pentaptera tomentosa.)
E.
पीत yellow, सार essence, aff. क, and र changed to ल.

m. (-मः)
A Brāhmaṇa, by whom the juice of the acid asclepias is drank at a ceremony.
E.
पीत, and सोम the juice.

m. (-न्धः)
A hog.
E.
पीत for पीन large, and स्कन्ध a shoulder.

m. (-कः)
A precious gem, the topaz.
E.
पीत yellow, and स्फटिक crystal.

m. (-न्धिः)
The Muni AGASTYA.
E.
पीत drank, (by whom,) and अब्धि the ocean; the saint having on one occasion swallowed up the sea.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Dressed in yellow clothes.
m. (-रः)
KṚṢṆA or VIṢṆU in that form.
2 A dancer or actor. []
3 A religious mendicant, wearing yellow garments.
E.
पीत yellow, अम्बर vesture, raiment.

n. (-श्म)
A topaz or any yellow gem.
E.
पीत, and अश्मन् a stone.

m. (-तिः)
A horse.
f. (-तिः)
1

Drinking.
2

A dram shop.
E.
पा to drink, aff. क्तिन्.

Turmerick.
2

Yellow jasmine.
E.
पीत yellow, कन् aff., and fem. form.

m. (-ती)
A horse.
E.
पा to drink, क्तिन् aff., इन् added.

m. (-तुः)
1 The sun.
2

Fire.
3

The chief elephant of a herd.
E.
पा to drink, (or dry up water,) and वुन् Uṇādi aff.

ind.
Having drank.
E.
पा to drink, क्त्वाच् aff.
